description: Cash out from this agent's private Solana balance to any Solana address (default: its own main wallet). Gloam's relay pays the fee. PUBLIC on chain: the private account, the destination, the asset and the amount. Passes the owner's spending limits as tool "pay" on network "solana-mainnet" (the destination must be an allowed recipient unless it is the agent's own main wallet).

amount.description: Amount in whole units, like "2.5" (not base units).

asset.description: SOL, USDC, USDT or ZEC (Zcash bridged to Solana by NEAR's Omni Bridge; private once added, the bridge and the add are public).

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Solana, in ms (default 120000). A send still unsettled then comes back pending with its signature and blockhash.

to.description: Destination Solana address (base58). Default: this agent's main wallet.

name: gloam_solana_cash_out
title: Cash out on Solana
